verifications.claim: According to a March 20, 2026 announcement from Chuck Norris's family, Chuck Norris has died at age 86.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: article dated 2026/03/20, 'has died at 86', family statement; R2: dated 2026/3/20, 'died at the age of 86', family statement on Friday; R3: dated 2026-03-21, 'died aged 86', family statement.
verifications.reasoning: Age 86 clearly supported across all; announcement timing matches article dates around March 20 but not explicitly 'March 20 announcement from family'.

verifications.claim: Chuck Norris passed away suddenly in Hawaii.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: 'sudden passing'; R2: 'sudden passing', 'hospitalised in Hawaii'; R3: 'sudden hospitalisation', 'hospitalised in Hawaii'.
verifications.reasoning: 'Sudden' directly supported; Hawaii via hospitalization but not explicitly 'passed away in Hawaii'.

verifications.claim: Chuck Norris passed away while surrounded by family.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'he was surrounded by his family and was at peace'; R2: 'he was surrounded by his family and was at peace'; R3: 'he was surrounded by his family and was at peace'.
verifications.reasoning: Directly quoted family statement in all sources.

verifications.claim: Chuck Norris passed away following a hospitalization for an undisclosed condition.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'hospitalised in Hawaii since Thursday, though details were not disclosed'; R3: 'hospitalised in Hawaii on Thursday for an undisclosed condition'.
verifications.reasoning: Direct support in R2/R3; R1 omits hospitalization but no contradiction.

verifications.claim: Al Jazeera notes that Chuck Norris's family has chosen to keep specific details of his death private.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2 (Al Jazeera): 'While we would like to keep the circumstances private'.
verifications.reasoning: Directly from Al Jazeera source quoting family.

verifications.claim: Chuck Norris's date of death is March 20, 2026.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'died Thursday' (article 03/20); R2: 'yesterday morning' (article 3/20, Friday → Thursday 19th); R3: 'hospitalised Thursday' (article 03/21).
verifications.reasoning: Sources imply Thursday March 19, not March 20; no source states March 20 as death date.

verifications.claim: Chuck Norris was 86 years old when he died.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'dies at 86'; R2: 'died at the age of 86'; R3: 'aged 86'.

verifications.claim: Chuck Norris was born on March 10, 1940.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.reasoning: R1/R2 support March 10; R3 contradicts with March 19.

verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R2: 'hospitalised in Hawaii'; R3: 'hospitalised in Hawaii'; R1 omits location.
verifications.reasoning: Hospitalized in Hawaii supports inference of death there, but not explicitly stated; R1 silent.

verifications.claim: Chuck Norris's cause of death is unknown/private.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'keep the circumstances private'; R2: 'keep the circumstances private', 'details were not disclosed'; R3: 'keep the details of his passing private', 'undisclosed condition'.
verifications.reasoning: Family explicitly states privacy; sources note undisclosed.

verifications.claim: Chuck Norris's death was a sudden passing after being hospitalized for an undisclosed condition.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: 'sudden passing'; R2: 'sudden passing', 'hospitalised... details not disclosed'; R3: 'sudden hospitalisation', 'undisclosed condition'.
verifications.reasoning: Combines 'sudden' (all) and hospitalization/undisclosed (R2/R3); R1 lacks hospitalization detail.

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'roles in “Walker, Texas Ranger”... most famed role'; R2: 'starred... Walker, Texas Ranger'; R3: implies via context.
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly described as famed/most famous role across sources.
